name: herdr-mcp
description: Monitor and control AI coding agents running in Herdr terminal workspaces

HERDR_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.title: Enable write operations
HERDR_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.description: Set to '1' to add the write tools (tab create, agent start, prompt, send-keys, rename, pane close). Leave empty for read-only mode, where those tools are not offered at all.

HERDR_MCP_MACHINE.title: Remote machine
HERDR_MCP_MACHINE.description: Optional: a saved herdr machine label or profile ID (see `herdr machine list`) to target instead of the local server.
